case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Several guests praised the friendly, helpful staff, cleanliness, and perceived good value for money, with many noting a simple but satisfactory breakfast and generally comfortable rooms with en‑suite bathtubs. Feedback also included contrasting room sizes—some found rooms spacious while one described a very tight layout—and isolated complaints about a sunken mattress, thin pillows, and a malfunctioning handheld shower; one guest mentioned family-friendly amenities and free parking.
